meta.title: Re-evaluation request shows reason, requester and original scores

steps.note: Open an existing event with a closed technical stage and an evaluation response available.
Navigate to the technical stage where the re-evaluation request line item can be opened.

args.goal: open a line item marked Re-evaluation Requested and verify that the request screen visibly shows the reason, the buyer who raised the request, and the original technical scores and recommendations

steps.note: Perform and verify the request-line interaction and all three required details on the screen.
Confirm the resulting request view has no rendering errors or unresolved values.
